question: Diving comes under which category of sport?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aquatic sport**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Diving comes under the **aquatic** category of sport.
 
• Diving is the sport of jumping or falling into water from a platform or springboard, usually while performing **acrobatics**.
 
• Diving is an internationally recognized sport that is part of the** Olympic Games**.
 
• In addition, unstructured and non-competitive diving is a **recreational pastime**.
 
• **Competitors** possess many of the same characteristics as gymnasts and dancers, including strength, flexibility, kinaesthetic judgment, and air awareness.
 
• Some professional divers were originally **gymnasts or dancers** as both sports have similar characteristics to diving.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• In many team sports, **defense**__ or defense is the action of preventing an opponent from scoring. The term may also refer to the tactics involved in defense or a sub-team whose primary responsibility is defense.
 
• __**Martial**__ arts are codified systems and traditions of combat practiced for a number of reasons such as self-defense; military and law enforcement applications; competition; physical, mental, and spiritual development; entertainment; and the preservation of a nation's intangible cultural heritage.
 
• A __**combat**__ sport, or fighting sport, is a competitive contact sport that usually involves one-on-one combat.
